value.rationale: For a positive exponential memory kernel, eventual coefficient positivity versus infinitely recurring sign loss is a natural and quantitatively useful long-horizon sign-robustness invariant, especially for positive localized inputs. The exact q=h lambda transition is a sharp control parameter not entailed by A-stability; it gives a structural distinction between decaying nonnegative-weight tails and permanent oscillatory tails. This is not presented as full-solver divergence or as a small routine parameter increment.
